description: Search published claims and source provenance by entity type, exact entity slug, claim record format and reliability class, with pagination. Claim types describe record formats, not topics. Alcohol declarations retain their exact wording; missing alcohol information is unknown, not zero. Beyond Wine is a published reference for no/low ABV specialty beverages in fine dining, including wine alternatives, craft ferments, kombucha, teas and blends. It excludes non-alcoholic beer, non-alcoholic spirits, mocktails, mixers, dealcoholized wine and blends containing dealcoholized wine. The connection cannot place orders or take payments and cannot guarantee every drink contains absolutely no alcohol.
name: search_claims
title: Search claims
